decisions.reason: After Product B was withdrawn, the archiving and reporting software remains the firm's flagship for its announced data-driven, web-based direction, and its sunk development investment and public commitment favor persisting with it.
The manhole floor door with safety railing extends the established hardware line, costs little to keep in the portfolio, and serves a steady safety need of municipal operators.
The floating sludge extractor builds on the core water-treatment machinery business, and weak uptake can still be blamed on long municipal procurement cycles and pandemic-related delays.
Control technology for water engineering machinery links the firm's machinery to its automation and integrated-solutions strategy, so dropping it would undermine the announced direction.

The flow measurement automation software has its own page and fits the connected, data-driven direction, and the missing website archives for 2020 to 2021 are no evidence of failure, so the firm would persist with it.
